# Expected skips on windows-latest (windows/amd64). Measured with
# `go test -race -json ./...` on a Windows 11 host; see README.md here.

# GitHub's hosted pool mixes CPU generations and does not guarantee AVX-512,
# so Z16–Z31 may not exist; the proof runs wherever they do.
github.com/deadpoets/secmem TestScrub_ClearsVectorRegistersZMMHi

# Seed #1 is the empty plaintext: a zero-length buffer is refused by the core
# by design, so this seed skips on every platform.
github.com/deadpoets/secmem/secmem-crypto FuzzOpenInto_RoundTrip/seed#1
